mine.blocks_next_point: The keyboard path breaks where it should be strongest. In my turn, ⌘K opened Commands with focus on the Close button, not on 'Find a command', so typing 'plan' did nothing and Return closed the sheet. Everything else holds up: the page is the learner's day, five faces are offered and each is shown in its own face, plus size, scheme and measure (shots/settings-dark), and face and scheme switched instantly in the real window. A few traces of app voice remain: 'Your earlier days will be here.', and the ⌘E prompt 'Where did you stop? One line for next time.' (shots/stop-dark).

calm.blocks_next_point: The open task is printed twice: once in the run of the page, and again as a pinned copy at the foot, set in a smaller size (shots/s3-after-dark: the 'slope … What is Km?' line appears at y≈181 and again at y≈484). In my turn the same standard-error question was on the page six times. The cold page itself is about as calm as it gets: a date, one suggested line with a Return key, one input line, and the previous day's date just showing at the bottom edge.

easy_to_start.blocks_next_point: In the real window the pick-up line is vague. After a week away it reads 'Pick up where you stopped on Thursday 5 November / Midterm 2 / Intro Statistics' (window/s5-week-dark): the exam's name, not the step you stopped on. The demo promises the actual line ('Reading Vmax and Km … at what the y-intercept gives'). On first run, 'Make a new folder' and 'Find folders already set up on this Mac' are plain sans text with no button affordance (shots/s1-cold-first-dark). Nothing on the start screen counts or owes.

flexible.blocks_next_point: In the live lesson, the exercise is lifted out of the tutor's bold Markdown and the seams show: an orphan '**' line above the task and a trailing '**' after it (live/s2-answer-dark, live/s4-return-dark). The pinned copy also drops the KaTeX italic on 'n' (live/s3-after-dark). The behaviour itself is right. Asked to change the plan, the real tutor asked for the new date, and the agenda stayed unchanged, which is truthful (live/plan-before.json = plan-after.json). The off-plan n − 1 answer got no margin mark, and the record holds one attempt. With the stand-in, the agenda updated in place with 'Moved from…', 'moved up' and 'moved down', plus a timed 'The plan changed.' line (window/s3-after-dark).

craft.blocks_next_point: The same element renders differently from state to state. The pinned task is about 8% smaller than the original prompt (same string: 354 px vs 324 px wide at 1x, shots/s3-after-dark). Only in s4-return does a task get a 'Task' label, and its green left rule is split into two segments with a gap of about 12 px (shots/s4-return-dark). Agenda items mix SF Pro with KaTeX serif maths ('Repair: reading Vmax and Km', shots/s2-start-light). Controls come in three unrelated styles: a keycap chip, bare text links, and a filled pill (shots/paper-dark). The base system is strong. Measured contrast: body 9.8 and 10.5:1, margin grey 5.2 and 4.66:1, green 8.0 and 5.9:1. The invitation lines fail AA: 'Or write on the page' is 3.27:1 in dark and 2.68:1 in light, and 'Or write your own first line' is 4.15 and 3.51:1, and these two greys don't match each other. The cold page's column sits left, with an empty right third reserved for an agenda that isn't shown.

clarity.blocks_next_point: 'Back to the task' in the demo goes back to the wrong task. It says 'You were on step 3' and re-poses the Vmax question, which is already marked 'right / unaided' above, instead of the open Km question (shots/s4-return-dark). The real window got this right (window/s4-return-dark). Also: two text lines are open at once, and the only signal of which one has the caret is a slightly darker underline. The Hint / I'm lost / I don't know row is grey text with no affordance.

performance.blocks_next_point: Startup to first content is 628–700 ms in window/perf.json (728–1029 ms in live/perf.json, 827 ms in my turn). That beats Obsidian, but it is not under the half-second native bar. Keystroke to paint is 17 ms median and 19 ms p95, just over one 60 Hz frame.

still_dislike: The open exercise is copied rather than moved. The original prompt stays in the page, and a second, smaller copy is pinned at the foot after every turn, so the page stacks duplicate questions (shots/s3-after-dark, window/s3-after-dark; in my turn the same question was on the page six times). Keep one exercise at one size, and leave a quiet one-line pointer where it was set.

Exercise extraction depends on the tutor's bold Markdown and leaks '**' in real lessons (live/s2-answer-dark, live/s4-return-dark). The pinned copy also loses the maths typesetting (live/s3-after-dark: 'which is n' in roman).

The keyboard and affordance details. ⌘K should land in 'Find a command', not on Close. The invitation lines need to reach 4.5:1, and should share one grey. The action row and first-run choices need some affordance beyond grey text, and controls should settle on one button language instead of keycap, link and pill.
